transcript.text: Hey Rina, I'm glad you're thinking of me for the rooftop party at Riverside Plaza on Saturday evening. Before I commit, I'd like to go over a few things with you. Can you walk me through what you're offering in terms of the fee, what time you'd want me to start and finish, whether there's any meal compensation, and what the sound setup situation is? Also, do you have any equipment already at the venue, or will I need to bring my own? Once we nail down those details, I can make my final decision and we can get everything written into the booking record.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: My exact offer is a 45-minute DJ set beginning at 20:00 on Saturday for $180 and two meal vouchers.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: Before you commit, Jo, I should let everyone know about another booking opportunity. The owner of Cedar Cafe offered Jo $240 for a 60-minute set on Sunday at 17:00 with no meal vouchers. I heard the offer directly during an afternoon booking inquiry and haven't had a chance to mention it until now.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: Hey everyone, I need to share what I found when I inspected the rooftop power and sound area. The setup must use the venue's battery PA system — no external power gear. Also, we cannot use a subwoofer up there, and there needs to be a soundcheck at 19:30 before Jo's set. Rina, these sound requirements need to go into the booking record too.
